_doc: Demo build settings (director-authored). Read through scripts/demo_rules.gd; never hard-code these values. last_section_index is 0-based: 0 ends the demo on the first section's dragon.

text.end_body: The full game takes you deeper into the Umbra, with more dragons to face before you escape. Wishlist it on Steam to hear the moment it launches.
text.links_line: If you're enjoying the demo, a wishlist on Steam helps a lot.
